description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf-front balcony with spectacular views - Heated community pool (Heated Nov-Apr)- 5-minute walk to Rosemary Beach- 10-minute walk to Alys Beach- Easy access to some of the area's best restaurants, including La Crema, Cowgirl Kitchen and Paradis in Rosemary Beach, George's and Caliza in Alys Beach. - 5-minute walk east to Crabby Steve's beach bar and restaurant, accessible only from the beach- Open concept kitchen, dining, and living- Smart TV in the living room- 4 adult bikes- This property only allows 2 cars per unit- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: This impeccable Seacrest Beach unit, "KYMA," has been completely refurbished and offers all the style and comforts one anticipates and expects in a luxury beach-front 30A property. A sophisticated palette of soft beach hues is complemented by the exquisite gulf waters and sugar-white sand. The coastal-inspired, beach-chic furnishings, amazing fixtures, and unique finishes reflect the coveted, relaxed 30A style. With a sprawling and open living, dining, and kitchen space overlooking the stunning Gulf of Mexico, it sets the perfect stage for entertaining friends and family.Comfortably sleeps 11 in this 4 bedroom, 3 full bath condo, including two master suites, one additional guest bedroom, and a bunk room. After a day in the sun at your backyard beach, take a dip in the community pool! Book your perfect beach getaway at "KYMA" today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 11):- Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Dual Head Shower Only- Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower and Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Bunk Beds with One Twin Trundle, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home.
